title: Parkio Daily for November 25, 2026
teaser: Animal Kingdom launches nighttime Kilimanjaro Safaris; Blizzard Beach closes three days this week; Bucky Barnes debuts at Avengers Campus.

rides.name: Kilimanjaro Safaris
rides.note: New Twilight Tales experience starts tonight

breaking.title: Blizzard Beach closes three days this week
breaking.body: The water park will be shut Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday during one of the busiest travel weeks of the year. No reason was given for the closures.

parkioInsight.text: Typhoon Lagoon is likely your only water park option this week. Consider booking a resort pool day instead if that park feels too crowded.

breaking.title: Magic Kingdom reports grand theft incident
breaking.body: Law enforcement responded to the park Tuesday afternoon for a reported grand theft. No details have been released about the incident or whether any guests were involved.

parkioInsight.text: Keep personal belongings secure in lockers on major attractions. Thanksgiving week crowds often mean tighter spaces and more opportunity for theft.

bignews.title: Animal Kingdom launches nighttime Kilimanjaro Safaris experience
bignews.body: Twilight Tales debuts today as the park extends evening hours into late 2026 and early 2027. The new after-dark version of the safari offers different animal activity and lighting.

parkioInsight.text: Animals tend to be more active at dusk than midday. Booking a safari slot between 6-8pm usually offers cooler temperatures and livelier wildlife behavior.

bignews.title: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova arrive at Avengers Campus
bignews.body: The two Marvel characters begin meet-and-greets at Disney California Adventure this week ahead of Avengers Doomsday opening in theaters December 18. Themed food and additional experiences are part of the rollout.

parkioInsight.text: Character meet queues in Avengers Campus tend to build after 11am. Arriving at rope drop usually gives you shorter waits for both heroes and Web Slingers.

bignews.title: Annual Passholder water park ticket price increases to fifty-four dollars
bignews.body: The discounted single-day water park ticket for passholders rose from its previous price. The new rate applies to both Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach.

parkioInsight.text: With Blizzard Beach closed three days this week, Typhoon Lagoon is likely to feel more crowded. Consider visiting after 3pm when families with young children often leave.

bignews.title: EPCOT Festival of the Holidays setup underway
bignews.body: Holiday Storyteller stages and decorations are being installed across World Showcase ahead of the festival launch Friday, November 27. The event runs through December 30.

parkioInsight.text: Opening day of EPCOT festivals tends to draw larger afternoon crowds. Visiting Friday morning before 11am usually means shorter lines for Cookie Stroll booths and Storytellers.

topstories.title: Glass panels added to Monstropolis building facades
topstories.body: Windows have been installed on distant buildings in the new Monstropolis land under construction at Hollywood Studios. The area will house a suspended coaster themed to Monsters Inc.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise near Sunset Boulevard tends to peak between 9am and 2pm. Plan quieter experiences like BaseLine Tap House or indoor shows during that window.

topstories.title: Two Disneyland attractions closing for January refurbishment
topstories.body: A pair of classic rides will shut down next month for maintenance work. Specific attraction names and closure dates have not yet been released.

parkioInsight.text: Late December tends to be the last chance to ride attractions going down in January. If you're visiting before New Year's, prioritize older favorites that may close soon.

topstories.title: Walt Disney the Dreamer merchandise collection arrives
topstories.body: New apparel, accessories, and collectibles honoring Walt Disney himself are now on shelves across Walt Disney World. The line includes a sixty-five dollar Tinker Bell special edition doll inspired by early Disneyland TV appearances.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition Disney collectibles often sell out within days at Emporium and World of Disney. Visiting those shops before 10am usually gives you first pick of new inventory.

topstories.title: Park icon sweatshirts debut for Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, and Hollywood Studios
topstories.body: Three new sweatshirts featuring the signature icon of each park are now available. Animal Kingdom and the two California parks are not yet included in the line.

parkioInsight.text: Popular apparel tends to disappear in common sizes by midday during Thanksgiving week. Stopping at the main shop in each park right at opening usually secures your size.

topstories.title: Avengers Campus construction beams show Mickey silhouette
topstories.body: Steel beams stamped with Mickey's iconic shape are now visible on the canopy framework rising over the expansion at Disney California Adventure. The structure continues to grow upward.

parkioInsight.text: Avengers Campus walkways tend to feel congested when guests stop to photograph construction. Cutting through Hollywood Land instead usually saves time getting to Cars Land or Grizzly Peak.

topstories.title: Gideon's Bakehouse releases Black Friday tiki mug and merchandise
topstories.body: The Disney Springs bakery will drop a new tiki mug and other exclusive items Friday, November 28 at 10am Eastern. Some products are online-only while others will be available at the East End Market location.

parkioInsight.text: Gideon's limited releases often sell out within the first hour. Joining the online queue at 10am sharp tends to give you the best shot at securing the new mug.

topstories.title: Disney Cruise Line debuts new gingerbread tower designs
topstories.body: The fleet's holiday decorations now feature redesigned gingerbread structures built by eighty crew members using over 700 pounds of powdered sugar and fondant. Life-sized gingerbread houses seen in past years are no longer part of the display.

parkioInsight.text: Gingerbread displays on cruise ships tend to draw crowds during embarkation afternoon. Visiting the atrium after dinner usually offers clearer photo opportunities.

icymi.title: Disneyland cancels Walt Disney Day pin release due to defects
icymi.body: A collectible pin planned for Tuesday was pulled from sale at both Disneyland and Walt Disney World after cast members reported quality issues. The status of the Florida drop remains unclear.

icymi.title: Disneyland loses top employer ranking in Orange County
icymi.body: After holding the number-one spot for four years, Disneyland Resort is no longer the largest employer in the county. The shift reflects broader changes in Southern California's economic landscape.

icymi.title: Disney and Formula 1 extend partnership for 2026 race season
icymi.body: Mickey and Friends return trackside as Disney continues its multi-year sponsorship of Formula 1. The collaboration includes activations at race venues and special experiences for fans.

spotlight.title: Columbia Harbour House remains Magic Kingdom's best counter-service option
spotlight.body: Despite Magic Kingdom's reputation for mediocre quick-service dining, this Liberty Square restaurant continues to deliver quality food in a quieter setting. The upstairs seating area offers a rare escape from the park's chaotic cafeterias.

parkioInsight.text: Columbia Harbour House upstairs seating tends to stay quiet even during peak lunch hours. Ordering between 11-11:30am usually lets you grab a table before the noon rush hits.
